CustomField.description: Used to display firing order of Price Rules. Used for reports, queries, and list views.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__TargetObject__c,"Configurator"),"1-Configurator","2-Calculator") +"-"+ IF( INCLUDES(SBQQ__EvaluationEvent__c, "On Initialization"),"1-On Initialization", IF( INCLUDES(SBQQ__EvaluationEvent__c, "Before Calculate"),"2-Before Calculate", IF( INCLUDES(SBQQ__EvaluationEvent__c, "On Calculate"),"3-On Calculate", IF( INCLUDES(SBQQ__EvaluationEvent__c, "After Calculate"),"4-After Calculate","")))) + IF(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__ConfiguratorEvaluationEvent__c,"Edit"),"1-Edit", IF(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__ConfiguratorEvaluationEvent__c,"Save"),"2-Save","")) +"-" +TEXT(SBQQ__EvaluationOrder__c)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays firing order of price rules. Sorting by this field will display the correct order in which the rules are fired.
CustomField.label: Sort Order
